text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, while integration tests make sure different parts work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach may feel slow at first, but it helps catch problems early. When tests are well written, developers gain confidence to change and improve their code without fear of breaking something. Good tests also make it easier for teams to work together, because everyone can see whether new changes cause problems. In short, testing is not just about finding bugs; it builds trust in the software.
